description: REPLACES (does not merge) the `data` object for a specific end user (the same object the SDK's neblla.db.save() writes and neblla.db.data shows). There is no merge option here, unlike the SDK which offers shallow/deep/crdt: whatever you pass becomes the whole document, so read it first with neblla_get_user, modify, and write it back — and be aware the user may be saving at the same moment. Use sparingly: this overwrites the user's saved state and the change is broadcast live. Useful for support (unstuck a user), moderation (clear a corrupted save), or admin tooling. If the app has a "bring your own database" target configured, this writes there. Mongo-reserved keys (starting with $ or containing ".") are rejected; total JSON size is capped at ~100KB and 10 levels deep.

data.description: The replacement data object (must be a plain object, not array/null)

name: neblla_update_user_data
